title: Cheapest Templates
description: This Minecraft Datapack offers a cheap recipie for any Smithing Template (Upgrade Template included) , Reusable Templates are not for 1.20.1 or below so ive decided to Fix it and make one Myself! This Datapack wont be for any other version than 1.20.1
body:
This Minecraft Datapack offers a cheap recipie for any Smithing Template (Upgrade Template included) , Reusable Templates are not for 1.20.1 or below so ive decided to Fix it and make one Myself! This Datapack wont be for any other version than 1.20.1

Recipe: Place any template you want to dublicate in the middle slot of an Crafting table, surround it with Cobblestone and youre done!
